title: Plastic Wizarding Of World Of Harry Potter Hogwarts Beer Stein Universal Studios
descriptionText: This plastic beer stein features the iconic Hogwarts crest from the beloved Harry Potter franchise. It is a must-have for any fan of the series and is perfect for adding a touch of magic to your home bar or collection. The stein is made from durable plastic and is ideal for both hot and cold beverages. It is a great addition to any Harry Potter or fantasy-themed collection and is sure to impress your guests.
